name: Jehiel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Shechaniah the son of Jehiel answers and says they have trespassed against their God in taking strange wives of the people of the land, yet there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

note.label: Ezra 10: The Covenant to Put Away Strange Wives
